C Tool Demonstrations

All 9 Objective C tools demonstrated:

  1. filter-by-queue (C++): selected queue demonstrations; all-queue summaries use one streaming pass
  2. filter-by-job (C++): single-vehicle event selection
  3. compute-use (C++): USE window metrics
  4. derive-event-metrics (C++): per-visit timings
  5. derive-sys-metrics (C++): system response/throughput
  6. plot-use (Python): USE plots below
  7. plot-sys-metrics (Python): system metrics plot below
  8. plot-derive-event-metrics (Python): visit histograms/scatter below
  9. create-event-trace (Python): event timeline below
